Questions from owners

Lake Keowee management FAQ

How much does Lake Keowee vacation rental management cost?

We charge a simple management fee on your booking revenue — we only make money when you do — with no hidden markups on cleaning or maintenance and no long-term contract. Contact us for a custom quote on your home.

What areas around Lake Keowee do you cover?

We serve the entire lake and the SC Upcountry — Sunset, Salem, Six Mile, Seneca, Keowee Key, and the Cliffs communities, plus nearby Clemson and Greenville.

Why choose a boutique manager over a big-box company like Vacasa or Evolve?

National companies rarely optimize your listing, are slow to respond to guests, and add fees that benefit their bottom line. We're local, owner-first, and treat your home like the asset it is.

Can you turn around an underperforming short-term rental?

Yes — it's what we do best. Better photography, smarter pricing, the right amenities, and multi-channel exposure routinely lift revenue without changing the bones of the home.

How do you handle the dock when the lake level changes?

Keowee is a Duke Energy reservoir with seasonal swings. We coordinate dock access and shoreline care so your guests always have a usable dock and a five-star experience.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No. We earn your business every month with performance and transparency — no long-term lock-in.
